name: Sanctuary
source:
Your friends annalynn call in a middle of the night,
you know something wrong with her
The next day, she offer you her job,
You accept and you discover that you will take care of mad person and maybe some... potential murderer.
[From [url=https://dwmlv.itch.io/sanctuary-project-jam] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的朋友安娜琳在半夜打来电话，你知道她出了什么问题。
第二天，她把自己的工作交给你。
你接受后发现，自己要照顾一个疯子，也许还有一个……潜在的杀人犯。

（来源：[url=https://dwmlv.itch.io/sanctuary-project-jam]itch.io[/url]）
